title: Suspicious Login Location Watch
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breach:alert event=login
| iplocation src_ip
| stats values(Country) as countries, count as logins by account
| eval foreign=if(mvcount(countries)>1,1,0)
| where foreign=1
description: Flags logins to your accounts from unexpected countries, an early sign of account compromise.
value: A login from a country you have never visited is a classic takeover signal worth acting on immediately.
implementation: Ingest account login events into `index=personal`; alert on logins from unexpected locations.
visualization: Map of account login locations with foreign-login flags.
grandmaExplanation: It flags logins to your accounts from unexpected countries, an early sign someone else may be in.
